# Suppressions for the `stale-refs` CI job (internal/tools/stalerefs).
#
# The job fails a PR when no producer emits a string any more but a consumer
# (e2e/, docs/, .github/) still quotes it. Two kinds of entry:
#
#   file:<path prefix>   hits under this path never count as stale references
#   <the literal>        this exact string never counts
#
# Every entry needs a reason above it. If you are adding one because a test
# broke, update the test instead — that is the finding, not the noise.

# --- forbidden-copy registries -------------------------------------------
# These files exist to ARCHIVE retired product copy and assert it never ships
# again. A hit in one is the file doing its job: the string is listed there
# BECAUSE nothing produces it any more.
file:e2e/envCopyStrings.ts
file:e2e/envCopy.test.ts

# --- assembled copy -------------------------------------------------------
# Strings the app builds at runtime from a template rather than storing whole.
# `git grep` cannot see the producer because the producer is an expression:
# roles.ts builds `Named in ${n} approval steps · those steps will block`, so
# the fully-rendered sentence exists only in the fixture that expects it.
# Measured false-positive class: 1 PR in 32 before this list existed.
Named in 2 approval steps
Named in 2 approval steps · those steps will block
Named in 5 approval steps
Ngozi Balogun +1
Engagement Manager +1
Folake Adesina +1

# --- orphaned fixture -----------------------------------------------------
# `Policy.updated` values in a module APPR-09 left fully unimported. Nothing
# reads them, so no reference here can break; APPR-10 deletes the file and
# this entry goes with it.
file:e2e/topology/policyFixtures.ts
